description: Authoritative update-source registry for Dragonwilds Sync managed runtimes and RSDW content. Changing a source requires only an approved repository commit; launcher code does not need to be rebuilt just to change an upstream URL.

rsdwtools.description: Canonical RSDW Toolkit website/editor source. Dragonwilds Sync stages and atomically promotes validated updates.

rsdw-icons.description: Canonical colored RSDW icon pack. Dragonwilds Sync maintains its own validated icon fingerprint/index so exact item-to-icon associations survive offline use.

rsdw-item-manifest.description: Canonical RSDW item JSON tree. Dragonwilds Sync validates the upstream item-editor association catalog against this tree, then maintains its own atomic manifest mapping display/internal/spawn identity, stack size and exact icon path.

runeschema.description: Launcher-managed RuneSchema core until an independent public upstream becomes available. Change this entry when RuneSchema moves.

ue4ss.description: Official UE4SS release source. Dragonwilds Sync keeps its own install/validation logic and never executes commands from this registry.

rsdwmodel.description: Avatar/model source used by the RSDW Toolkit character experience.
